whyLisSample.text: Keep Your Independent Spirit—just Add Hilton: retain hotel individuality and local character while accessing Hilton Honors, global sales, Hilton Supply Management, and revenue systems.
Remarkable Characters: hand-picked upper-upscale hotels in sought-after urban and resort destinations—198 open across 47 countries (May 2026 fact sheet).
Culinary-Forward Positioning: world-class F&B from beachfront cocktails to chef-driven tasting menus—not generic hotel dining.

Conversion-Ready Within Brand Standards Economics: commercial agreement materials supports conversion, adaptive reuse, and new development—model ~50.8% loyalty mix and ~88.5% Hilton channel contribution from your disclosure sample.
Fit: owners and operators who can run full-service experiential hospitality with design QA and F&B discipline—not breakfast-only limited-service.
